chapter: Clarifications and portraits: Lester Young, Byas, Blanton, Ben Webster
title: The harmonica band at Booker T. Washington High
summary: He played in a school harmonica band and clowned as a turkey on stage.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Oh, you were talking about how active you had been at Booker T. Washington High School in Tulsa. You told me being associated with the Harmonica Band. Does that mean you played harmonica?
You hadn't mentioned that when you talked about your instruments.

Oh, yeah. Well the bandmaster (Professor Jeff) formed a harmonica band. And you know harmonicas have numbers on it and we learned to read on harmonica. And we were going to give a little concert in the auditorium. The day of the concert, someone stole my harmonica. (Laughter). Or I mislaid it, I don't know what happened. I was in the wings while they were out on the stage playing. And the ham that was in me, they started playing 'Turkey in the Straw' and I strutted across the stage doing like a turkey. (Laughter). Broke up everybody. Teachers, students, mother was there, she fell out. (Laughter).
I had to be in the show. (Laughter).
Did you ever get another harmonica and play anymore?
Yes, I got another harmonica. I got a chromatic harmonica but I didn't do much with it.
